equal_columns: Splits the photo and the details 50 / 50. On for the HandySCAN page.
enable_sticky_add_to_cart: A bar with the cart button while visitors scroll. Keep off on the HandySCAN page: the site has no cart.
ts_frame: The thin vertical page lines. The HandySCAN page uses **Rails, no inner padding**, like the other pages.
ts_crumbs_strip: Shows the breadcrumbs (Home / product name) in a ruled strip above the photo and the details. Keep it on.
